# AFX DEX Developer Documentation

AFX DEX is a decentralized perpetuals exchange with an AI-agent-friendly API surface.

## Primary Docs

- Public API Reference: https://afx-docs.gitbook.io/afx/api-reference
- Source overview: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afx-dex/afx-docs/main/index.md
- Quick start: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afx-dex/afx-docs/main/quickstart.md
- Agent safety: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afx-dex/afx-docs/main/agent-safety.md
- Python SDK: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afx-dex/afx-docs/main/sdk.md
- Signing: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afx-dex/afx-docs/main/signing.md
- Exchange API: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afx-dex/afx-docs/main/openapi/exchange.yaml
- Info API: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afx-dex/afx-docs/main/openapi/info.yaml
- WebSocket API: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/afx-dex/afx-docs/main/openapi/websocket.yaml
